name: Convox

evidence.panel: 01: open-source Convox Rack is installed in the customer's own cloud account as a Kubernetes PaaS
evidence.paas: 03: Convox Cloud is managed hosting; Convox runs the applications on its own infrastructure

line: Deploy apps to your cloud account or Convox managed cloud.

free.text: Console: 1 user/1 Rack; X-Small Cloud machine has 250 free hours/month

cells.selfhost: Yes; Rack runs in your cloud account

work.math: $12 a month for the X-Small machine, which includes 250 free machine hours and 100 build minutes. Data sent out and domain costs are not published.
$199 a month for the Basic Console, plus the provider's rack, node, load balancer, data sent out and domain. The provider and region are not selected.
$25 for Cloud Small + $19 for a Cloud DB dev database = $44 displayed subtotal. The database docs say managed RDS, but the pricing FAQ says it is not directly available.
